caveats: Patches exported offline from final recorded working trees; no rebuild or new device validation performed for publication.
Production kernel reused 438 accepted V27 modules; this source export does not include that binary module cohort or complete external SynAP source closure.
Standalone DTS is the same source already added by 0001; it is provided for inspection, not a boot-ready DTB. Firmware runtime fixups and padded accepted DTB are separate artifacts.
SL1680 L2 placement is an opt-in board workaround; original SEA root cause and other boards or RAM maps are not validated.
Original Yocto 4.0.17/glibc 2.35/native compiler and hybrid/v1 cgroups retained; newer userspace and unified LXC migration deferred.
Saved-default deployment and repeat boot passed in local evidence; automatic bounded production recovery is unavailable, and manual power cycling may be required.
Tool wrappers and deployment sources retain private binary/evidence/device prerequisites; source export is not a self-contained installer.
